name: light_veladora
kind: light texture (PointLight2D) for each veladora: an always-lit, very weak ambient pool, not a safe zone
centre_note: px-edge coordinates from the top-left = the texture centre (PointLight2D centres its texture on the node). Put the node on the veladora's wick (ritual_veladora.json anchors.wick). The core sits ~2 px NE of the centre on purpose (the rings are not concentric).
scale_note: review at the whole-number art scale 3 (pool radius ~45-50 texture px = ~140 art px = ~1.8 u) = texture_scale 1.2 in world px (1 u = 32 world px = 80 art px). The old altar lights were the 256 px lamp_pool.tres gradient at texture_scale 1.05. Light textures may only scale by whole numbers.
filter: nearest (project default_texture_filter 0), so the bands stay hard
energy_note: 4 low bands, peak #8d817b (0.53), no #bab4aa core: the brief's 'very weak, keep the bands low'. One or two read as a faint warm pool on the altar top; with all 8 altar slots lit the Add lights stack and the cloth goes flat peach, so lower the per-candle energy (or light fewer) if the game fills the altar (for Beti / the Godot session).
placement_note: two veladoras side by side show the same lump twice; rotate or flip one light node by 90 / 180 degrees in Godot so neighbours don't look stamped (the texture stays nearest-sampled)
design: option A 'low, long tail' (critic pick), shortened after the critics: a #8d817b core ~19 px across ~2 px NE of the wick, a #605551 ring 3-4 px on the NE and ~10 px on the SW, a lumpy #473e3c body and a #272323 rim 11-25 px wide with 2-3 broad lobes; no band under 3 px, no edge straight for more than 8 px
